answer: Ration entry with scarce invite tokens: each established account mints one token every ten epochs, and a newcomer can join only by spending one. Tokens never come in bulk, so fifty fakes need either five hundred epochs of honest seniority or fifty real sponsors, each docked if its invitee is caught. Picture the network as an oasis fed by a slow tide into a small lagoon: water arrives at a fixed pace, so nobody can flood it overnight, and every fake drinks from a sponsor's share.
